notes.title: Ver1.0.1 has been released!
notes.content:

notes.title: 【Shinobi non Grata #6】2 Minibosses Unveiled！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/163b8b809e13d0bd68f04c8f17c0fa4851cdabda.png[/img]

Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed during the Bakumatsu-era!

We have some exciting information about 「[b]Shinobi non Grata[/b]」! 

In this issue of Shinobi non Grata #6, we are excited to introduce[b] 2 Minibosses[/b]！

※The capacity of the GIF image is adjusted to balance the size. 

[h3]Miniboss　大百足Great Centipede[/h3]

[previewyoutube=ouHF37QQ98w;full][/previewyoutube]

It's sinuous movement is out of this world (in a bad way).

Even in a safety zone, the enemy bullet will attack you...the Great Centipede a formidable enemy indeed!


[h3]Miniboss　鵺Nue[/h3]

[previewyoutube=0TqKsZSNoGM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Japanese version of a chimera,「Nue」, is another boss that hinders your path.

Avoid the enemy bullets while concentrating on attacking Nue's huge body！



[h3]Afterwords[/h3]

After seeing all of this in【Shinobi non Grata #6】, what do you think of it? 

Here is the【Shionbi non Grata】STEAM Store page. Please be sure to
[b]add it to your wishlist！[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/00404f54913fb916caa2a9ddeefd1f944c3a8d3e.gif[/img]
If you want to set a record, this is made for you！

More information on games from Flyhigh Works are available to read up on Flyhigh Times.
Please feel free to check it out!

notes.title: 【Shinobi non Grata #3】Introducing shinobi weapons「Kusarigama」and「Bombs」!【Shinogu
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/163b8b809e13d0bd68f04c8f17c0fa4851cdabda.png[/img]

Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed during the Bakumatsu-era!

We have some exciting information regarding[b]「Shinobi non Grata」[/b], which is scheduled for release in 2022! 

In this issue of 【Shinobi non Grata #3】, we will introduce shinobi weapon (and sub-weapon) that appears in the story, the 「Kusarigama」and「Bombs」!


[h3]Kusarigama[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/eeef5c0bec73f781917b1252a1e6be3ac79507b0.gif[/img]

The kusarigama causes damage from a distance, and it appears to be able to[b] disable enemies' firearms as well！[/b]



[h3]Bombs[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/dc3a6625d289ade2ea9b646cabb56036bfae650b.gif[/img]

It appears that bombs can [b]attach to an enemy and, after it's detonated, they will damage other enemies and objects nearby[/b]. It's a strategic method to use it.

～～～～～

This now concludes【Shinobi non Grata #3】. What did you think about it?

That’s the end of this article!
